title: DonutShop
description: A exact replica of /shop and /sell of DonutSMP server
body:
DonutShop - The Ultimate Replica

DonutShop is a exact replica 1:1 of DonutSMP server /shop and /sell

Its a simple shop to buy items and sell items on a GUI, made for SMP

Use /shop to buy items, /sell to sell items, simple as that

✨ Core Features:
![shop gui](https://i.imgur.com/2UPKTgd.gif)
![sell gui](https://i.imgur.com/zBWM6JL.gif)
![sell history gui](https://i.imgur.com/fuzReqy.gif)

  Requirements:
- Spigot/Paper: >= 1.21.x
- Vault: (Required for money economy)
- Economy plugin (You can use EssentialsX)
- PlayerPoints: (Optional, for shards economy)
  
Note: A free license key from our Discord is required to use this plugin.
https://discord.gg/edzKrjZ8hf
